title: Onboard Aurora-X 13B v2.0 + automate changelog generation
author: Priya Singh
description: Background: Aurora-X is a commonly used 13B model in customer workloads. v2.0 introduces improved transformer kernel fusion and a quantization-friendly checkpoint which changes perf/latency tradeoffs. Motivation: add v2.0 to the model registry with curated metadata and performance profiles, and wire it into our changelog/release-notes automation so new model onboarding emits standardized notes and perf deltas. Summary of changes: 1) Add model metadata and manifest for aurora-x v2.0; 2) Add performance profiles (latency/cost/throughput) generated from perf-canary runs; 3) Extend changelog automation script to include model registry changes and auto-generate release notes snippets; 4) Add CI smoke tests for onboarding workflow and perf regression check. Checklist: - [x] Model artifact manifests added - [x] Performance profiles validated on staging GPUs - [x] Changelog generation integrated into release pipeline - [x] Unit + integration tests added - [x] Docs updated with model summary Notes: Perf runs were executed using the benchmark-lab on p4d instances (mixed precision). We include both 512 and 2k token profiles. The changelog automation will create a /changelogs/models/YYYY-MM-DD-aurora-x-13b-v2.0.md snippet and a release entry in the auto-release-notes aggregator. Rollout: staged rollout — registry entry created in staging, smoke tests ran, then merged to main which will trigger the automated release note draft for the upcoming release. Related: ENG-3121 (onboarding process improvements), PM-1982 (release prioritization).

release_notes:
- Onboard aurora-x 13B v2.0: new metadata, model card, and curated performance profiles (512 & 2048 token workloads).
- Perf improvements: ~12% lower p50 latency on 2k tokens (staging runs), p95 numbers included in perf_profiles.
- Automation: changelog/release notes generator updated to include model-registry diffs and perf deltas; outputs standardized snippets for releases.
notes_for_ops: Staging rollout completed. When promoting to production, ensure the registry index is updated and the release-notes aggregator picks up the generated snippet. Perf profiles include recommended default serving configs (quantization profile and batch target). For Dedicated customers using pinned v1 variants, routing remains unchanged — v2.0 will be available as a separate model id.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: minor perf regressions on specific hardware/quantization combos. Mitigation: perf-smoke test and automatic rollback guidance in the onboarding workflow; manual verification checklist added. Customers with stricter SLAs can opt to pin to aurora-x-13b-v1.
